title: echinochloa crus-galli var. pumila
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli var. pumila, commonly known as Short Millet or Small Barnyard Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Echinochloa crus-galli var. pumila are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
